core_meaning.short_meaning: Tiller of the soil, cultivator; guardian, watcher
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haris is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Tiller of the soil, cultivator; guardian, watcher”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haris corresponds to the Arabic form حارث (Arabic root ح ر ث (ḥ-r-th); حَارِث (Ḥārith)). Its core sense is guardian, custodian, watcher. Haris is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic حَارِث (Ḥārith) 'tiller of the soil, cultivator; guardian, watcher', from the root ح ر ث (ḥ-r-th). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave هاريس (the English name 'Harris') as the Arabic form; the correct Arabic form حارث is given here. The source gloss 'guardian, custodian' reflects the related حارس (ḥāris, 'watchman'). Same name as haaris (batch 26).
